question: Q07
test: Does a player listed 1st (or 2nd) string on the club depth chart actually appear in that team-week's participation data?
definition: 'Agreement' = the listed player has a snap-count row for that team-week. This measures presence only. It does NOT measure whether he started, how many snaps he took, or whether he out-snapped the backup.
interpretation_guard: Second-string players should NOT be expected to appear every week; a high appearance rate for 2nd string would suggest the chart is not really a depth ordering. Compare the two rows rather than reading either alone.
caveats: Presence in snap counts means at least one snap, including special teams.
Players traded or renamed mid-season may fail the name join.
Depth charts may be published at a different cadence than weekly, so some team-weeks may reuse a stale chart.
This does not establish that the depth chart is a reliable replacement map; it only quantifies how often the listed player appears at all.
